quality_check.description: Vertical abstract screen-print material sample using bone white, pale stone, soot black, storm blue-gray, oxidized teal and sparse vermilion, with bold silhouettes, diagrammatic lines, coarse print grain, halftone-like fields and visible registration wear.
violations: Aspect ratio appears slightly wider than an exact 9:16 vertical format.
The composition reads more like an abstract arranged print study than a clearly segmented palette-and-texture reference sheet, though it remains a non-scene material sample.

material_anchor_v2.neutral_material.evidence: The canvas is occupied by an edge-to-edge abstract print sample with overlapping ink masses, line treatments and palette relationships; there is no book, doorway, character, location, enclosing page border or inset illustration.
